blocks.prompt: 15 (i) Express in the form \(r\sin(\theta + \phi)\) or \(r\sin(\theta - \phi)\), where terminal sides of the angles of measures \(\theta\) and \(\phi\) are in the first quadrant: \(24\sin\theta + 7\cos\theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Humein \(24\sin\theta + 7\cos\theta\) ko ek hi sine ki shakal mein likhna hai, jis mein \(r\) (amplitude, yani sab se bari value) aur \(\phi\) (phase angle) ho, aur \(\phi\) quadrant I mein ho.
\(\cos\theta\) wala term jama hai, is liye \(r\sin(\theta + \phi)\) lenge.
Plan: form ko expand karo, coefficients milao, square kar ke jama karo to \(r\), divide karo to \(\tan\phi\) (bilkul Example 10 ki tarah).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(24\sin\theta + 7\cos\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: \(r > 0\) aur quadrant I ka \(\phi\), taake \(24\sin\theta + 7\cos\theta = r\sin(\theta + \phi)\).
Tareeqa: form ko kholein:
\[r\sin(\theta + \phi) = r\cos\phi\sin\theta + r\sin\phi\cos\theta\]
phir di hui expression se milayen. Yeh tareeqa physics mein waves jodne mein bhi istemaal hota hai: do waves ka jama ek hi wave ban jata hai.

Coefficients milayen
\[r\cos\phi = 24 \quad \text{(1)}\]
\[r\sin\phi = 7 \quad \text{(2)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(\sin\theta\) ke saath wala number barabar hona chahiye aur \(\cos\theta\) ke saath wala bhi. Minus sign hum ne form mein hi le liya hai, is liye \(r\sin\phi\) positive rakha.
Dhyan dein: Form ka sign chunne se pehle dekh lein ke \(\cos\theta\) wala term plus hai ya minus; isi se \(\phi\) quadrant I mein rehta hai.

Square kar ke jama karein, \(r\) milega
\[r^2(\cos^2\phi + \sin^2\phi) = r^2\]
\[r^2 = 24^2 + 7^2 = 576 + 49 = 625\]
\[r = 25\]
Kyun: Dono equations ko square kar ke jama kiya; \(\cos^2\phi + \sin^2\phi = 1\) hone se sirf \(r^2\) bacha. \(r\) length jaisi cheez hai, is liye positive root liya.

(2) ko (1) se divide karein, \(\phi\) milega
\[\tan\phi = \dfrac{7}{24}\]
\[\phi = \tan^{-1}\dfrac{7}{24} \approx 16.26^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{r\sin\phi}{r\cos\phi}\) mein \(r\) cancel ho kar \(\tan\phi\) bachta hai. \(\sin\phi\) aur \(\cos\phi\) dono positive hain, to \(\phi\) waqai quadrant I mein hai, jaisa sawal ne kaha.

Jawab likhein
\[24\sin\theta + 7\cos\theta = 25\sin(\theta + \phi)\]
Kyun: \(r\) aur \(\phi\) ko chune hue form mein rakh diya.

Tasdeeq: rakhein \(\theta = 90^{\circ}\)
\[24(1) + 7(0) = 24\]
\[25\sin(90^{\circ} + \phi) \]
\[= 25\cos\phi = 25 \cdot \dfrac{24}{25} = 24 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yahan \(\cos\phi = \frac{24}{25}\); dono sides barabar aayin, is liye jawab sahi hai.
